correctness.rationale: Ulam d=6−LCS is invariant under common symbol relabeling. Fix identity among codewords; exactly132 other S6 permutations have d≥4, with 612 compatible edges among these 132. Independent exact LCS dynamic-programming enumeration gave 298 compatibility triangles and zero extendable triangles (so maximum4, no size5). Every triangle yields normalized four-word maximum, hence exactly 298*720/4=53640 labeled maxima; independently built and deduplicated all 53640. Each such maximum has all six distances exactly4. Independently enumerated 1440-group orbits using just transposition, cycle relabeling and position reversal generators; obtained 57 orbits (seven360, twenty-nine720, twenty-one1440). Checked every normalized maximum lacks subgroup closure, excluding left subgroup cosets. All counts are exhaustive finite calculations for S6, not extrapolation.
